title: CTCD city display coordinates and mapped sample counts
purpose: Display metadata for the global observational-evidence map. Coordinates locate city markers only and are not analytical variables or inputs to thermal-demand reconstruction, control selection, building simulation or statistical inference.

coordinate_source.record_urls: Stored row by row in ctcd_city_map_metadata.csv

overlap_screened_office_records.definition: Overlap-screened CTCD office observations retained after the declared office, activity, validity and overlap filters.

active_conditioning_records.definition: Rows in CTCD_ALIGNED_OFFICE_RECORDS.csv.gz with the declared active-conditioning operation flag.

executable_profiles.definition: Active-conditioning records with an executable demand profile under the locked reconstruction pipeline.

map_use.recommended_main_manuscript_layer: Filter active_conditioning_records > 0 and size markers with active_conditioning_records. This gives the 10 cities and 12,427 observations described in the main manuscript.
map_use.broader_observational_archive_layer: Use overlap_screened_office_records. This retains every city represented in the broader overlap-screened office archive, including one Yantai observation.
map_use.controller_input_layer: Filter executable_profiles > 0 and size markers with executable_profiles.
map_use.warning: Do not label all 14,725 mapped observations as active-conditioning controller inputs; the corresponding controller-input total is 12,404.

dataset_citation.authors: Yang, L.; Zhao, S.; Zhai, Y.; Gao, S.; Wang, F.; Lian, Z.; et al.
